relationship.reason: A peer-reviewed conference paper identified by DOI and a dataset repository identified by repository/files/checksum/licence are distinct citable source objects even when the paper reports work using the related corpus. Dataset rights, participant governance and cultural-access restrictions must not be inherited from or replaced by paper-access status, and paper copyright/access must not be treated as dataset reuse permission.
relationship.numeric_difference_not_normalized_away: The paper exact-locator audit reports 26,868 final sentence-recording pairs whereas the upstream dataset README reports 26,870 recordings. This audit preserves the discrepancy rather than forcing equality; it may reflect curation/versioning but that explanation is not verified here.

master_reconciliation.reason_not_promoted_to_new_identity: The relationship is now resolved, but permanent source assignment is deferred until the standalone MMSC register is updated atomically with census metrics and source-register tests; this run does not alter audited identity counts merely to claim progress.
